title.narrative: Strengthening Local Systems and Partnerships for More Effective and Sustainable Counter Trafficking in Persons in the Philippines (Strength CTIP-P)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .USAID, through the Strength CTIP-P activity, bolsters local systems and partnerships for more effective and sustainable CTIP programs by supporting priority CTIP interventions in line with the U.S. government CTIP strategy. USAID works to: enhance local and community-based mechanisms and strategies to prevent TIP; strengthen protection and reintegration services to victims; increase victims' access to legal services; and expand partnerships at the community and institutional levels to improve prevention, protection, and prosecution. FY 2022 TIP-earmarked funds will: advance priority recommendations in the Department of State's TIP report to strengthen local government units (LGUs) to provide reintegration services for survivors; raise support for government and NGOs' programs that provide specialized care for victims of trafficking; expand resources for anti-trafficking task forces to conduct timely investigations, coordinated operations, and prosecutions, while providing robust victim and witness assistance services; and increase support for returned overseas workers and trafficking victims. USAID will: enhance the capacity of multi-sectoral anti-TIP task forces to more effectively carry out their mandates; support the establishment and strengthening of a comprehensive victim-sensitive protection system that provides community-based care and interagency and multidisciplinary coordination in the provision of services to victims; and bolster the capacity of community watch groups and formal local anti-trafficking mechanisms. USAID will roll out an economic empowerment toolkit for target communities to help reduce vulnerabilities and build resiliency to trafficking. In the area of prosecution, USAID will help LGUs establish and train multi-disciplinary teams to support victims in legal action filings and proceedings..
